content.text: {"answer": 2, "reduction": 2, "lower_bound": 2, "upper_bound": 2, "lower_bound_mechanism": "finiteness of minimal transversals (blocker) of the pairwise-intersecting family {P(a_i)}, via pruned search tree + König", "upper_bound_mechanism": "S = union of multiples of b_j is a union of residue classes mod L = lcm(b_j); count T residues in each window, valid for all n>=1", "wrong_answer_stated": false, "notes": "Correct route: replaces large-prime erasure by a finite-blocker lemma (true, and here argued in general). Characterization of terms as S-members >= a_1 and the mod-L counting giving a_{n+T}=a_n+L from n=1 are both correct. Only weakness: the tree 'pruning/contraction' step is imprecisely defined; a clean induction on |C| would be tighter."}
